summary_paragraph: A male patient was admitted with pleuritic chest pain and left lower quadrant abdominal pain, both starting two days prior. He had stopped his Lovenox due to running out of the prescription. Workup including CT imaging and cardiac enzymes ruled out pulmonary embolism, acute coronary syndrome, and intra-abdominal pathology. Pain was managed with diclofenac and a PPI, avoiding opioids due to a history of medication abuse. Lovenox was restarted at a lower, once-daily dose for prophylaxis. The patient was discharged home with follow-up arranged with primary care and the chronic pain clinic. His condition at discharge was stable with normal oxygen saturation.
problems: Personal history of venous thrombosis and embolism
